newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco postpones tender for 130,000 tonnes wheat.
newsitem.headline: Morocco postpones tender for 130,000 tonnes wheat.

text.p: Morocco postponed a tender for the purchase of 130,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat because prices were too high, an official at the Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses (ONICL) said on Tuesday.
"The tender was not conclusive because the prices were too high for us," the official told Reuters.
Morocco had tendered on Monday for a total 130,000 tonnes of wheat to be shipped in August and September, he said.
European traders, who put the size of the tender at 120,000 tonnes, said Morocco had been offered wheat at less than $155 per tonne, cost and freight.
ONICL said the offer was not satisfactory but declined to give any figures.
Morocco was expected to return to the international market with a tender on Wednesday, a Moroccan trader said.
